Lakers Nation > Blog > Lakers News > JJ Redick: Lakers Respond To Level Of ‘Insanity’ Collin Sexton Brings To Court Lakers News JJ Redick: Lakers Respond To Level Of ‘Insanity’ Collin Sexton Brings To Court
 Corey Hansford Published: 10/27/2026 3 Min Read Oct 25, 2026; Salt Lake City, Utah, USA; Los Angeles Lakers guard Collin Sexton (10) warms up before a game against the Utah Jazz at Delta Center. Mandatory Credit: Rob Gray-Imagn Images SHARE Perhaps the unsung hero of the Los Angeles Lakers’ 132-123 comeback victory over the Utah Jazz was guard Collin Sexton. The 13 points Sexton provided off the bench were important, but even more important was the energy and intensity he brought from the moment he stepped out on the floor.
 Sexton entered the contest to start the second quarter with the Lakers trailing by 18 and the energy immediately shifted. He picked up full court, harassing the Jazz ball-handlers, and attacked the rim relentlessly on offense as well. And head coach JJ Redick recognized how the rest of the Lakers responded to him.
 “I think there’s a level of insanity with him and I think our team responds to insanity,” Redick said on Spectrum SportsNet . “It’s a good thing. He comes in the game and you know he’s in the game. I think defensively he’s trying to apply ball pressure. He’s trying to make hard closeouts. He’s trying to push the basketball. He’s trying to touch the paint. There’s an intensity to all that stuff and our guys responded.”
 The Lakers were lifeless in the first quarter, allowing open shots and offensive rebounds while looking like a team that didn’t want to be there and couldn’t match the energy and physicality of their opponents. Matching energy will never be a problem for Sexton and is infectious across the rest of the team. 
 Once things pick up and the momentum shifts just a little bit, everyone else feeds into it. Sexton, along with Austin Reaves, increased the energy in that second quarter and suddenly Jake LaRavia, Ziaire Williams and Matisse Thybulle are flying around everywhere and the Lakers’ defense that was non-existent in the first quarter, is stifling in the second. Then when Luka Doncic gets back on the court, the offense goes to another level as well and things keep flowing from there.
 In a long, 82-game season, there are gonna be nights where a team just doesn’t have it, but someone like Sexton who brings the insanity as Redick calls it, can mitigate those contests and help to turn them from disappointing losses into comeback wins .
 Collin Sexton sees opportunity to make an impact for winning Lakers team
 Sexton also understands that bringing that energy and intensity is a big part of his role for this Lakers team. And after years of being part of losing franchises, he is looking forward to the opportunity to contribute for a winning one.
